pararhabdodon:eswiki:5.title: Pararhabdodon isonensis (Materiales referidos de otros sitios)

facts.statement: The genus Pararhabdodon was named by Casanovas-Cladellas, Santafé-Llopis, and Isidro-Llorens in 1993.
facts.quote: authority: Casanovas-Cladellas, Santafé-Llopis & Isidro-Llorens, 1993

facts.statement: Pararhabdodon lived during the Late Cretaceous period.
facts.quote: fossil_range: Late Cretaceous,

facts.statement: Pararhabdodon means "near fluted tooth" and is a lambeosaurine hadrosaurid from the Maastrichtian of Spain.
facts.quote: Pararhabdodon (meaning "near fluted tooth" in reference to Rhabdodon) is a genus of lambeosaurine hadrosaurid dinosaur from the Maastrichtian-aged (Late Cretaceous) Tremp Group of Spain.

facts.statement: The first remains of Pararhabdodon were found at Sant Romà d'Abella, initially assigned to Rhabdodon before being named Pararhabdodon isonensis in 1993.
facts.quote: The first remains were discovered from the Sant Romà d'Abella fossil locality and assigned to the genus Rhabdodon, and later named as the distinct species Pararhabdodon isonensis in 1993.

facts.statement: Pararhabdodon was one of the last non-avian dinosaurs to go extinct during the Cretaceous-Paleogene extinction event.
facts.quote: It was one of the last non-avian dinosaurs known from the fossil record that went extinct during the Cretaceous-Paleogene extinction event.

facts.statement: Additional fossil material revealed that Pararhabdodon is a hadrosaur, not a primitive iguanodontian as initially thought.
facts.quote: Later discoveries of additional material revealed its true nature as a hadrosaur.

facts.statement: In 2009, evidence supported that Pararhabdodon is a lambeosaurine closely related to the Chinese genus Tsintaosaurus.
facts.quote: In 2009 evidence was put forward that it was indeed a lambeosaurine, and more specifically a close relative of Tsintaosaurus, a genus from China.

facts.statement: In 2020, a study proposed that Pararhabdodon belongs to the group Arenysaurini, related to other European lambeosaurs.
facts.quote: A different position, related to other European lambeosaurs in the group Arenysaurini, was proposed in 2020.

facts.statement: Excavation of Pararhabdodon specimens began in Spring 1985 at the Sant Romà d'Abella locality in the Pyrenees, Spain.
facts.quote: Excavation of specimens that would later be used to erect Pararhabdodon began in Spring 1985, at the Sant Romà d'Abella (SRA) locality (in the Pyrenees near Isona, Lleida, Spain) of the Talarn Formation in the Tremp Group.

facts.statement: New remains excavated in 1990 led to the naming of Pararhabdodon isonense in 1993.
facts.quote: New remains from this site, excavated in 1990, brought about a reconsideration of the material, and Casanovas-Cladellas and colleagues named it as the new genus and species Pararhabdodon isonense in 1993.

facts.statement: The species name was corrected from isonense to isonensis in 1997 by Laurent and colleagues.
facts.quote: The species name was corrected to isonensis in 1997 by Laurent et al.

facts.statement: In 1999, Casanovas-Cladellas and colleagues identified Pararhabdodon specifically as a lambeosaurine hadrosaur.
facts.quote: In 1999 it was more specifically identified as a lambeosaurine hadrosaur, in a paper again by Casanovas-Cladellas et al.

facts.statement: Known material from the type locality includes maxillae, vertebrae, a sacrum, ribs, an ischium, a scapula, an ulna, and a humerus.
facts.quote: In total, known material from the type locality includes: a left and a right maxilla; five cervical, five dorsal, and one caudal vertebra; a sacrum; fragmentary rib bones; one end of the right ischium; a fragment of the left scapula, an ulna and a humerus.

facts.statement: All known material from the type locality was found on a 4 m by 2.5 m surface and is thought to belong to a single individual.
facts.quote: All of this material was excavated from a 4 m by 2.5 m surface, and it is thought to have belonged to a single individual.

facts.statement: In 2013, a maxilla specimen (MCD 4919) was referred to Pararhabdodon isonensis because it possessed traits of the tsintaosaurin tribe.
facts.quote: A maxilla, specimen MCD 4919, was referred to P. isonensis in 2013. It possessed traits of the tsintaosaurin tribe which Pararhabdodon was by that point assigned to.

facts.statement: A 2019 paper questioned the referral of specimen MCD 4919 to Pararhabdodon isonensis due to a differing ectopterygoid shelf compared to the holotype.
facts.quote: A 2019 paper questioned the referral of MCD 4919 to P. isonensis. The specimen was found to have a differing ectopterygoid shelf compared to the maxilla of the holotype, which would conflict with belonging to the same species.

facts.statement: A 2013 study evaluated whether Blasisaurus canudoi and Arenysaurus ardevoli were synonyms of Pararhabdodon isonensis, but refrained from concluding they were the same species pending more data.
facts.quote: The same 2013 study also evaluated Blasisaurus canudoi, from the Blasi 1 locality of the underlying Arén Formation, and Arenysaurus ardevoli, from the Blasi 3 locality of the La Posa Formation, another part of the Tremp Group.

facts.statement: The 2020 description of Pararhabdodon hindlimb material allowed researchers to rule out Arenysaurus as a synonym, as their femurs are anatomically distinct.
facts.quote: The Pararhabdodon himdlimb described in 2020 allowed for synonymy with Arenysaurus to be ruled out, as the femurs of the two taxa were anatomically distinct.

facts.statement: The Basturs Poble bonebed, a hadrosaur site, was discovered in the Conques Formation during the late 1990s.
facts.quote: A hadrosaur mega-bonebed, later termed the Basturs Poble bonebed, was discovered in outcrops of the Conques Formation during the late 1990s.

facts.statement: It is debated whether the Basturs Poble bonebed represents one species or two, though a single variable species is currently considered most likely.
facts.quote: It has been debated whether the material represents a singular species or a combination of two distinct ones; but today a single, variable species is considered most likely.

facts.statement: The 2020 hindlimb description solidified the distinction between Pararhabdodon and the Basturs Poble bonebed material due to inconsistent femoral anatomy.
facts.quote: The 2020 hindlimb description allowed for distinction between Pararhabdodon and the Basturs Poble material to be solidified, with the bonebed material showing inconsistent femoral anatomy with the genus.

facts.statement: In the 1990s, paleontologist Marc Boada discovered a new fossil site near the village of Abella de la Conca in the Talarn Formation.
facts.quote: Near the village Abella de la Conca, in the 1990s, palaeontologist Marc Boada discovered a new site in the Talarn Formation, bearing dinosaur fossils.

facts.statement: A right dentary designated as specimen IPS SRA 27 was excavated from the Les Llaus site.
facts.quote: From this site, later named Les Llaus (LL), a right dentary, specimen designation IPS SRA 27, was excavated.

facts.statement: A 2006 re-evaluation by Albert Prieto-Márquez and colleagues corrected the dentary's location to the LL locality, placing it 750 meters away and 9 meters below the SRA locality.
facts.quote: In 2006, the stratigraphy of the region was re-evaluated by Albert Prieto-Márquez and colleagues, and the dentary's location was corrected to the LL locality, 750 m away from and 9 m below the SRA locality.

facts.statement: In 2009, Prieto-Márquez and Jonathan R. Wagner provided evidence suggesting Koutalisaurus should be synonymized with Pararhabdodon.
facts.quote: Evidence for this synonymy would later come in a 2009 study, from Prieto-Márquez alongside Jonathan R. Wagner.

facts.statement: In 2013, Prieto-Márquez and colleagues re-examined the dentary in a broader study of European hadrosaurs.
facts.quote: Prieto-Márquez returned again to the dentary in 2013, in a study alongside colleagues providing a review and investigation of hadrosaurs from all over Europe.

facts.statement: Further preparation revealed that the unique features of the dentary were exaggerated by reconstructions done in the 1990s.
facts.quote: Further preparation of the specimen in the time since his last study regarding it revealed the uniqueness of the dentary had been exaggerated significantly by reconstruction of the specimen when it was first prepared in the 1990s.

facts.statement: After correcting for reconstruction errors, the dentary is indistinguishable from multiple lambeosaurines and has no specific connection to Tsintaosaurus.
facts.quote: Correcting for the inaccuracies, the Los Llaus dentary is indistinguishable from that of multiple lambeosaurines, and shares no particular connection to Tsintaosaurus.

facts.statement: The reasoning for assigning the dentary to Pararhabdodon was voided, and it is now considered an indeterminate lambeosaurine dentary.
facts.quote: With this, their reasoning for assignment of the specimen to Pararhabdodon was voided, and the specimen is now considered a completely indeterminate lambeosaurine dentary.

facts.statement: Pararhabdodon was a bipedal-quadrupedal herbivore.
facts.quote: Pararhabdodon would have been a bipedal-quadrupedal herbivore.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen of Pararhabdodon is estimated to have been around 6 meters long.
facts.quote: The holotype specimen is estimated to have been around 6 m long.

facts.statement: Histological analysis suggests the holotype was not fully grown, implying the species likely reached sizes similar to relatives like Corythosaurus and Tsintaosaurus, around 9 meters long.
facts.quote: Histological analysis indicates the individual was not fully grown, and so the species likely reached similar sizes to North American and Asian relatives such as Corythosaurus and Tsintaosaurus (around 9 m long).

facts.statement: Despite living on an island, Pararhabdodon did not exhibit insular dwarfism, reaching sizes similar to mainland relatives like Adynomosaurus.
facts.quote: This is despite Pararhabdodon living on an island, something generally associated with insular dwarfism, a phenomenon exhibited in other European hadrosaurs; Adynomosaurus was cited as a similar example, being around the same size.

facts.statement: When first discovered, the specimens were initially thought to belong to the genus Rhabdodon rather than a new taxon.
facts.quote: When the first specimens were originally discovered and described by Casanovas-Cladellas and colleagues, they were not thought to belong a new taxon at all, but merely to belong to the genus Rhabdodon, and of an uncertain species.

facts.statement: The specimens were recognized as a unique species and given the name Pararhabdodon in 1993.
facts.quote: Not long after, they would be recognized of those of a unique species, and in 1993 they were given their modern name.

facts.statement: In 1994, the discovery of two maxillae led researchers to classify Pararhabdodon as a species of hadrosaur.
facts.quote: In 1994 these cranial remains would be found - two maxilla - and these would be used by the original authors to establish it as a species of hadrosaur.

facts.statement: In 1999, researchers argued that Pararhabdodon was a primitive member of the subfamily Lambeosaurinae, making it the first known European species of this group.
facts.quote: Casanovas-Cladellas et al. revised their position for a final time in 1999, when they published a paper arguing for a position as a primitive member of the hadrosaur subfamily Lambeosaurinae - this made it the first such species known from the continent of Europe.

facts.statement: In 2001, Jason Head challenged the idea that Pararhabdodon was the first known European lambeosaurine by re-evaluating Eolambia caroljonesa.
facts.quote: The proposal that P. isonensis was the first known European lambeosaurine was soon challenged, however, in 2001 by Jason Head, in a study re-evaluating the status of another species, Eolambia caroljonesa, as a primitive lambeosaur.

facts.statement: Research found that both Pararhabdodon and Eolambia were more primitive hadrosauroids, positioned basally to the split between Lambeosaurinae and Hadrosaurinae.
facts.quote: Both Pararhabdodon and Eolambia were found to instead be more primitive hadrosauroids more basal than the split between Lambeosaurinae and "Hadrosaurinae" (later renamed to Saurolophinae).

facts.statement: A 2006 phylogenetic analysis classified Pararhabdodon as a non-hadrosaurid hadrosauroid, supporting earlier arguments by Jason Head.
facts.quote: In the 2006 re-evaluation of the genus by Albert Prieto-Márquez and colleagues, it was included in a phylogenetic analysis for the first time. This found it to be a non-hadrosaurid hadrosauroid, a similar position as had been argued by Head.

facts.statement: Multiple shared traits united Pararhabdodon with Tsintaosaurus and identified it as a member of the subfamily Lambeosaurinae within Hadrosauridae.
facts.quote: Multiple synapomorphies were found uniting to the two taxa, as well as identifying Pararhabdodon as a member of the subfamily as opposed to outside of Hadrosauridae.

facts.statement: A 2020 study found that all European lambeosaurs, including Pararhabdodon, formed a single monophyletic clade named Arenysaurini.
facts.quote: In a 2020 study describing and naming Ajnabia, Nicholas Longrich and colleagues found a novel arrangement of lambeosaur phylogeny. As opposed to European lambeosaurs being spread across different lineages, all members of the subfamily from the continent — including Pararhabdodon — were found to form one monophyletic clade, which was therein named Arenysaurini.

facts.statement: The genus Pararhabdodon was named by Casanovas-Cladellas, Santafé-Llopis, and Isidoro-Llorens in 1993.
facts.quote: genus_authority: Casanovas-Cladellas, Santafé-Llopis & Isidoro-Llorens, 1993

facts.statement: The species Pararhabdodon isonensis was named by Casanovas-Cladellas, Santafé-Llopis, and Isidoro-Llorens in 1993.
facts.quote: species_authority: Casanovas-Cladellas, Santafé-Llopis & Isidoro-Llorens, 1993

facts.statement: Pararhabdodon lived during the Maastrichtian stage of the Late Cretaceous.
facts.quote: Category:Maastrichtian dinosaurs

facts.statement: Fossils of Pararhabdodon have been found in the Tremp Formation.
facts.quote: Category:Tremp Formation

facts.statement: Pararhabdodon is a dinosaur genus found in Spain.
facts.quote: Category:Dinosaurs of Spain

facts.statement: The proposal that Pararhabdodon was the first known European lambeosaurine was challenged in 2001 by Jason Head.
facts.quote: The proposal that P. isonensis was the first known European lambeosaurine was soon challenged, however, in 2001 by Jason Head, in a study re-evaluating the status of another species, Eolambia caroljonesa, as a primitive lambeosaur.

facts.statement: Pararhabdodon isonensis is the only known species in the extinct genus Pararhabdodon.
facts.quote: Pararhabdodon isonensis es la única especie conocida del género extinto Pararhabdodon

facts.statement: Pararhabdodon is an ornithopod dinosaur classified as a hadrosaurid.
facts.quote: de dinosaurio ornitópodo hadrosáurido

facts.statement: Pararhabdodon lived during the late Cretaceous period, between 67 and 66 million years ago in the Maastrichtian stage of what is now Europe.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, entre 67 a 66 millones de años, en el Maastrichtiense, en lo que es hoy Europa

facts.statement: The first remains of Pararhabdodon were discovered at the fossil locality of Sant Romà d'Abella in the Tremp Formation of Catalonia, Spain.
facts.quote: Los primeros restos fueron descubiertos en la localidad fósil de Sant Romà d'Abella en la Formación Tremp de Cataluña, España

facts.statement: The remains were initially assigned to the genus Rhabdodon before being named the distinct species Pararhabdodon isonensis in 1993.
facts.quote: y asignados al género Rhabdodon y posteriormente nombrados como la especie distinta Pararhabdodon isonensis en 1993

facts.statement: Known material includes a variety of postcranial remains, mostly vertebrae, as well as cranial maxillae.
facts.quote: El material conocido incluye una variedad de restos postcraneales, en su mayoría vértebras , así como maxilares del cráneo

facts.statement: Specimens from other sites, including remains from France, a maxilla previously considered the distinct taxon Koutalisaurus kohlerorum, additional maxillae, material assigned to the genera Blasisaurus and Arenysaurus, and the extensive bone bed of Basturs Poble, have at various times been considered to belong to the species, but all these assignments have been questioned more recently.
facts.quote: Especímenes de otros sitios, incluidos restos de Francia, un maxilar anteriormente considerado el taxón distinto Koutalisaurus kohlerorum, un maxilar adicional de otra localidad, el material asignado a los géneros Blasisaurus y Arenysaurus y el extenso lecho óseo de Basturs Poble se han considerado en diferentes momentos para pertenecen a la especie, pero todas estas asignaciones han sido cuestionadas más recientemente

facts.statement: Initially, it was thought that the material belonged to a rhabdodontid or some other type of primitive iguanodontid.
facts.quote: Inicialmente, se pensaba que el material pertenecía a un dinosaurio rabdodontido o algún otro tipo similar de iguanodóntido primitivo

facts.statement: Pararhabdodon was likely a herbivore that alternated between bipedal and quadrupedal positions.
facts.quote: Pararhabdodon habría sido un herbívoro que alternaba entre la posición bípeda y cuadrúpeda

facts.statement: The holotype specimen is estimated to have measured around 6 meters in length.
facts.quote: Se estima que el espécimen holotipo medía alrededor de 6 metros de largo

facts.statement: Histological analysis indicates the holotype individual was not fully developed, suggesting the species likely reached sizes similar to North American and Asian relatives like Corythosaurus and Tsintaosaurus, around 9 meters in length.
facts.quote: El análisis histológico indica que el individuo no estaba completamente desarrollado, por lo que la especie probablemente alcanzó tamaños similares a los parientes norteamericanos y asiáticos como Corythosaurus y Tsintaosaurus, alrededor de 9 metros de largo

facts.statement: Despite living on an island, a condition generally associated with insular dwarfism, Pararhabdodon reached large sizes, contrasting with the phenomenon seen in other European hadrosaurs like Adynomosaurus.
facts.quote: Esto es a pesar de que Pararhabdodon vive en una isla, algo generalmente asociado con el enanismo insular , un fenómeno exhibido en otros hadrosaurios europeos, Adynomosaurus fue citado como un ejemplo similar, siendo aproximadamente del mismo tamaño

facts.statement: Excavation of specimens that would later serve to erect Pararhabdodon began in the spring of 1985 at the locality of Sant Romà d'Abella in the Pyrenees near Isona, Lleida, Spain, from the Talarn Formation in the Tremp Group.
facts.quote: La excavación de ejemplares que posteriormente servirían para erigir Pararhabdodon se inició en la primavera de 1985, en la localidad de Sant Romà d'Abella, en los Pirineos cerca de Isona, Lérida, España, de la Formación Talarn en el Grupo Tremp

facts.statement: In 1987, Casanovas-Cladellas et al. described remains of a Catalan ornithopod, including a cervical vertebra, some partial dorsal vertebrae, a humerus, and a fragmentary scapula, as Rhabdodon sp.
facts.quote: En 1987, Casanovas-Cladellas et al. describió restos de un ornitópodo de Cataluña, incluyendo una vértebra cervical, algunas dorsales parciales, un húmero y una escápula fragmentaria , como Rhabdodon sp.

facts.statement: New remains from this site, excavated in 1990, prompted a reconsideration of the material, leading Casanovas-Cladellas and colleagues to name it the new genus and species Pararhabdodon isonense in 1993.
facts.quote: Nuevos restos de este sitio, excavados en 1990, provocaron una reconsideración del material, y Casanovas-Cladellas y sus colegas lo nombraron como el nuevo género y especie Pararhabdodon isonense en 1993

facts.statement: At that time, it was still considered a basal iguanodontid similar to a Rhabdodon, hence the name, where the generic name referred to Isona.
facts.quote: En ese momento, todavía estaba considerado como un iguanodontido basal parecido a un Rhabdodon, de ahí el nombre, el nombre genérico se refería a Isona

facts.statement: In 1994, additional material was collected from the type locality, including two maxillae, two dorsal vertebrae, a complete sacrum, two fragmentary ribs, and a partial ischium.
facts.quote: En 1994 se recopiló material adicional de la localidad tipo, incluidos dos maxilares, dos vértebras dorsales, un sacro completo , dos costillas fragmentarias y un isquion parcial

facts.statement: The species name was corrected to P. isonensis in 1997 by Laurent et al.
facts.quote: El nombre de la especie fue corregido a P. isonensis en 1997 por Laurent et al.

facts.statement: The new material, the most important cranial and mandibular elements, led the Casanovas-Cladellas team to reclassify it as a hadrosaurid instead of a basal iguanodontid.
facts.quote: El nuevo material, los elementos craneales y mandibulares más importantes, los del cráneo, llevaron a que el equipo de Casanovas-Cladellas lo reclasificara como un hadrosáurido en lugar de un iguanodontido basal

facts.statement: In 1999, it was identified more specifically as a lambeosaurine hadrosaurid in an article by Casanovas-Cladellas et al., making it the first member of the subfamily on the continent and the second valid hadrosaurid, preceded by Telmatosaurus and the dubious Orthomerus.
facts.quote: En 1999 fue identificado más específicamente como un hadrosáurido lambeosaurino, en un artículo nuevamente de Casanovas-Cladellas et al.. Esto lo convirtió en el primer miembro de la subfamilia del continente, y el segundo hadrosáurido válido, precedido por Telmatosaurus y el dudoso Orthomerus

facts.statement: In 2020, Jesús F. Serrano and colleagues described new hindlimb material from the site, found in 2018.
facts.quote: En 2020, Jesús F. Serrano y sus colegas describieron nuevo material de extremidades traseras del sitio, encontrado en 2018

facts.statement: Its placement within the group remained controversial; in 1999 it was proposed to belong to the subfamily Lambeosaurinae, making it the first known from the European continent, but later studies questioned this, classifying it instead as a more primitive hadrosaurid.
facts.quote: Su ubicación dentro del grupo siguió siendo controvertida, en 1999 se propuso que pertenecía a la subfamilia Lambeosaurinae, lo que la convierte en la primera conocida del continente europeo. Estudios posteriores cuestionaron esto, clasificándolo en cambio como un hadrosauroide más primitivo

facts.statement: In 2009, evidence was presented that it was indeed a lambeosaurine, and more specifically a close relative of Tsintaosaurus, a genus from China. This position has been found repeatedly since then, and the group containing them was later named Tsintaosaurini.
facts.quote: En 2009 se presentó evidencia de que de hecho era un lambeosaurino, y más específicamente un pariente cercano de Tsintaosaurus , un género de China. Esta posición se ha encontrado repetidamente desde entonces, y el grupo que los contenía se llamó más tarde Tsintaosaurini

facts.statement: In 2020, a different position was proposed, relating it to other European lambeosaurines in the group Arenysaurini.
facts.quote: En 2020 se propuso una posición diferente, relacionada con otros lambeosaurinos europeos en el grupo Arenysaurini

facts.statement: In 1997, Laurent and colleagues referred remains from the Le Bexen site in the Upper Cretaceous of Aude, southern France, to the genus Pararhabdodon.
facts.quote: En su artículo de 1997, Laurent y sus colegas refirieron restos del sitio Le Bexen del Cretácico superior de Aude, en el sur de Francia, al género.

facts.statement: A first-hand study in 2013 supporting these conclusions re-evaluated European lambeosaurine material.
facts.quote: Un estudio de primera mano para una revaluación de 2013 del material lambeosaurino europeo apoyó estas conclusiones.

facts.statement: In 2013, Prieto-Márquez and colleagues used material previously referred to Pararhabdodon to establish the new taxon Canardia garonnensis.
facts.quote: Prieto-Márquez y col. en 2013 utilizaron este material para establecer un nuevo taxón, Canardia garonnensis.

facts.statement: A maxilla, specimen MCD 4919, was referred to P. isonensis in 2013.
facts.quote: Un maxilar, espécimen MCD 4919, fue referido a P. isonensis en 2013.

facts.statement: The specimen was discovered at Serrat del Rostiar 1, part of the Conques Formation and Tremp Group, but in a lower stratigraphic section, making it older than the type locality.
facts.quote: El ejemplar fue descubierto en la localidad de Serrat del Rostiar 1, parte de la Formación Conques, parte del Grupo Tremp al igual que la localidad tipo, pero en una sección inferior de los estratos , lo que la hace más antigua.

facts.statement: A 2019 article questioned the referral of specimen MCD 4919 to P. isonensis.
facts.quote: Un artículo de 2019 cuestionó la remisión del MCD 4919 a P. isonensis.

facts.statement: The description of Pararhabdodon himdlimb in 2020 allowed the synonymy with Arenysaurus to be discarded because the femurs of the two taxa were anatomically distinct.
facts.quote: El Pararhabdodon himdlimb descrito en 2020 permitió descartar la sinonimia con Arenysaurus , ya que los fémures de los dos taxones eran anatómicamente distintos.

facts.statement: A mega-bonebed of hadrosaurs, later named the Basturs Poble bonebed, was discovered in outcrops of the Conques Formation in the late 1990s.
facts.quote: Un mega-lecho de hadrosáuridos, más tarde denominado lecho de huesos de Basturs Poble, fue descubierto en afloramientos de la Formación Conques a finales de la década de 1990.

facts.statement: The same 2013 study also evaluated Blasisaurus canudoi from locality Blasi 1 in the underlying Arén Formation and Arenysaurus ardevoli from locality Blasi 3 in the La Posa Formation, both parts of the Tremp Group.
facts.quote: El mismo estudio de 2013 también evaluó Blasisaurus canudoi, de la localidad Blasi 1 de la Formación Arén subyacente y Arenysaurus ardevoli, de la localidad Blasi 3 de la Formación La Posa, otra parte del Grupo Tremp.

facts.statement: Near the village of Abella de la Conca, in the 1990s, paleontologist Marc Boada discovered a new site in the Talarn Formation containing dinosaur fossils.
facts.quote: Cerca de la aldea Abella de la Conca , en la década de 1990, el paleontólogo Marc Boada descubrió un nuevo sitio en la Formación Talarn, que contenía fósiles de dinosaurios.

facts.statement: In 1997, Casanovas-Cladellas and colleagues declared that this dentary was discovered at Sant Romà d'Abella, the site where the original Pararhabdodon remains were found.
facts.quote: En 1997, Casanovas-Cladellas y sus colegas declararon que este dentario fue descubierto en Sant Romà d'Abella, el sitio donde se encontraron los restos originales de Pararhabdodon.

facts.statement: In 2006, Albert Prieto-Márquez and colleagues re-evaluated the region's stratigraphy and corrected the dentary's location to Les Llaus, 750 meters away and 9 meters below the Sant Romà d'Abella locality.
facts.quote: En 2006, la estratigrafía de la región fue revaluada por Albert Prieto-Márquez y sus colegas, y la ubicación del dentario se corrigió a la localidad Les Llaus, a 750 metros de distancia y 9 metros por debajo de la localidad Sant Romà d'Abella.

facts.statement: The authors noted the possibility that future discoveries could lead to the synonymization of their taxon with P. isonensis.
facts.quote: Los autores señalaron la posibilidad de que futuros descubrimientos conduzcan asinonimización de su taxón con P. isonensis.

facts.statement: Evidence for this synonymy came later in a 2009 study by Prieto-Márquez and Jonathan R. Wagner.
facts.quote: La evidencia de esta sinonimia vendría más tarde en un estudio de 2009, de Prieto-Márquez junto a Jonathan R. Wagner.

facts.statement: Prieto-Márquez returned to the dentary in 2013 in a study with colleagues providing a review and investigation of hadrosaurs across Europe.
facts.quote: Prieto-Márquez regresó nuevamente al dentario en 2013, en un estudio junto con colegas que proporciona una revisión e investigación de hadrosáuridos de toda Europa.

facts.statement: It possessed traits of the tribe Tsintaosaurini to which Pararhabdodon was assigned at the time.
facts.quote: Poseía rasgos de la tribu Tsintaosaurini a la que Pararhabdodon estaba asignado en ese momento.

facts.statement: It was referable to Pararhabdodon specifically due to the rostrocaudally wide region of the maxilla, a trait exclusive to P. isonensis within the tribe.
facts.quote: Era referible a Pararhabdodon en particular debido a la región rostrocaudal rostrocaudalmente amplia del maxilar, un rasgo exclusivo de P. isonensis dentro la tribu.

facts.statement: Because the specimen was still recognized as having tsintaosaurine characteristics, the authors considered it likely belonged to a close relative of P. isonensis.
facts.quote: Como todavía se reconocía que el espécimen tenía características de tsintaosaurino, los autores aún consideraban que probablemente pertenecía a un pariente cercano de P. isonensis.

facts.statement: It was demonstrated that the previously claimed diagnostic traits of the two taxa are found in other hadrosaurs.
facts.quote: Se demostró que los rasgos de diagnóstico previamente reclamados de los dos taxones se encuentran en otros hadrosáuridos.

facts.statement: The same 2013 study evaluated Blasisaurus canudoi and Arenysaurus ardevoli, noting that their unique traits were insufficient to confirm separate species status without overlapping fossil evidence.
facts.quote: El mismo estudio de 2013 también evaluó Blasisaurus canudoi, de la localidad Blasi 1 de la Formación Arén subyacente y Arenysaurus ardevoli, de la localidad Blasi 3 de la Formación La Posa, otra parte del Grupo Tremp.

facts.statement: The 2020 description of hind limbs solidified the distinction between Pararhabdodon and Basturs Poble material, as the bonebed material showed femoral anatomy inconsistent with the genus.
facts.quote: La descripción de las patas traseras de 2020 permitió que se solidificara la distinción entre Pararhabdodon y el material de Basturs Poble, y el material del lecho óseo mostraba una anatomía femoral inconsistente con el género.

facts.statement: An autapomorphy, a unique trait used to diagnose the taxon as a new species, was a very elongated toothless section on the dentary extending medially inward.
facts.quote: Se usó una autapomorfia, rasgo único para diagnosticar el taxón como una nueva especie, una sección desdentada muy alargada en el dentario, que se extendió medialmente, hacia adentro.

facts.statement: It was found that Tsintaosaurus specimens showing a similar condition had been distorted by a similar process.
facts.quote: Se encontró que los especímenes de Tsintaosaurus que mostraban la condición similar habían sido distorsionados por un proceso similar.

facts.statement: With this, the reasoning for assigning the specimen to Pararhabdodon was nullified, and the specimen is now considered a completely indeterminate lambeosaurine dentary.
facts.quote: Con esto, su razonamiento para la asignación del espécimen a Pararhabdodon fue anulado, y el espécimen ahora se considera un dentario lambeosaurino completamente indeterminado.

facts.statement: The parent group of Pararhabdodon is Arenysaurini.
facts.quote: Parent group: Arenysaurini

facts.statement: Pararhabdodon belongs to the family Hadrosauridae.
facts.quote: Family: Hadrosauridae

facts.statement: Pararhabdodon is classified in the class Ornithischia.
facts.quote: Class: Ornithischia

facts.statement: Pararhabdodon lived during the Maastrichtian stage, from 72.2 to 66 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Maastrichtian to Maastrichtian (72.2 to 66 million years ago)

facts.statement: The referral extended the genus's range further within the Upper Maastrichtian.
facts.quote: La remisión a Pararhabdodon extendió así el rango del género aún más dentro del Maastrichtiano superior.

facts.statement: It is debated whether the Basturs Poble bonebed material represents a single species or a combination of two distinct ones, but it is now considered more likely to be a single variable species.
facts.quote: Se ha debatido si el material representa una especie singular o una combinación de dos distintas; pero hoy en día se considera más probable una única especie variable.

facts.statement: However, due to a lack of suitable comparison material and the absence of Tsintaosaurini characteristics in the bonebed material, it has recently been suggested that it should be considered indeterminate lambeosaurine material.
facts.quote: Sin embargo, debido a la falta de cualquier material adecuado para la comparación y la falta de características de Tsintaosaurini en el material del lecho óseo, se ha sugerido más recientemente que en su lugar debería considerarse material lambeosaurino indeterminado.

facts.statement: The authors refrained from considering any of the taxa as representatives of a species pending more data.
facts.quote: Los autores se abstuvieron de considerar a ninguno de ellos como representante de una especie en espera de datos de más material.

facts.statement: Because both Talarn Formation taxa shared unique traits with the Asian genus, authors decided to treat them as a single species, as keeping them separately would be misleading to non-specialists who likely could not distinguish them; they were kept separate conservatively rather than due to strong evidence of two hadrosaurs in the area.
facts.quote: Como ambos taxones de la Formación Talarn rasgos compartidos de forma única con el género asiático, los autores decidieron tratar a los dos como una sola especie, ya que mantenerlos como provisionalmente separados sería engañoso para los no especialistas, que probablemente no distinguirían los dos taxones se mantuvieron separados para ser conservadores y no debido a la fuerte evidencia de dos hadrosaurios en el área.

facts.statement: Correcting inaccuracies, the Los Llaus dentary is indistinguishable from that of multiple lambeosaurines and shares no particular connection with Tsintaosaurus.
facts.quote: Corrigiendo las inexactitudes, el dentario de Los Llaus es indistinguible del de múltiples lambeosaurinos, y no comparte ninguna conexión particular con Tsintaosaurus.

facts.statement: A 2019 article questioned the referral of MCD 4919 to P. isonensis, finding that the specimen had a different ectopterygoid platform compared to the holotype maxilla, which would conflict with belonging to the same species.
facts.quote: Un artículo de 2019 cuestionó la remisión del MCD 4919 a P. isonensis. Se encontró que el espécimen tenía una plataforma ectopterigoidea diferente en comparación con el maxilar del holotipo, lo que entraría en conflicto con la pertenencia a la misma especie.

facts.statement: The 2020 description of Pararhabdodon himdlimb allowed the distinction from Arenysaurus to be confirmed based on anatomically distinct femurs.
facts.quote: El Pararhabdodon himdlimb descrito en 2020 permitió descartar la sinonimia con Arenysaurus , ya que los fémures de los dos taxones eran anatómicamente distintos.
